component.name: BattleTanx: Recompiled
component.summary: Static recompilation of BattleTanx for PC.

description.p:
BattleTanx: Recompiled is a project that uses N64: Recompiled to statically recompile BattleTanx into a native port with many new features and enhancements. This project uses RT64 as the rendering engine to provide some of these enhancements.
The original game is required to run this project.
